scope: Review index, not a runtime schema or authorized data import. Source records remain separate and are linked by stable reference IDs. Every original blocker remains unresolved until the responsible domain adopts reviewed evidence.
rules: No unknown becomes zero, empty, absent, healthy, credentialed, paid or accessible. No candidate may be activated from this manifest.
Never combine full-roster endowment references with M1-A synthetic accounts. Never copy private candidate values into public narrative.
Review material means a proposal exists, not proof, completeness, approval or percentage of game completion. Preserve all 12 full-slice NPCs.
Source pins must be reverified before adoption; changed data requires explicit reconciliation. No peer-owned file modified.

separate_fixture_fences.full_roster: Four #101 candidate packs plus #96 opening finance reference (whole CR). No live balances, agreements or accounts.
separate_fixture_fences.m1a: Separate noncanonical age-16 fixture and adult worker role; #96 M1-A finance uses 1800 minor/hour, denominator 3600000, 100 minor employer endowment. Do not substitute roster accounts or actual NPC-0001 identity.
separate_fixture_fences.receipt_fixture: Earlier #99 contract example uses 10 minor/second, 90 minor at 9 seconds. It is a distinct synthetic receipt-shape example, not M1-A wage authority. M1-A 9 seconds conditionally earns 4 minor with carry 1800000; 60 seconds conditionally earns 30. Neither fixture constitutes an actual work receipt.
separate_fixture_fences.clock: #101 civil opening example 05:00 precedes reference caretaker 08:00 shift. #96 M1-A uses unspecified reviewed weekday instant within eligible work window. Do not reuse the full-roster opening instant to claim compensable work; explicitly specify a separate reviewed fixture instant.
separate_fixture_fences.next: Agree D1/D2/D3/D4/D6 and D8. Use M1-A as bounded engineering milestone after review; full roster and complete slice remain required.
